chapter_summary: Gu Suizhou is taken into custody by the Administration Department for investigation regarding the W.N drug and alleged illegal human experiments. Despite his calm demeanor and insistence that he is innocent of the charges, Shen Feizhi later discovers from his associate C2 that Gu Suizhou's high pheromone compatibility with him was artificially engineered by Gu himself. The chapter reveals through a flashback that Gu Suizhou suffered severe health complications and 'pseudo-heat' after Shen Feizhi left five years ago, forcing him to take extreme measures to survive and continue his plans.
